title: General W4 recovery beyond path and equal-star slices
objective: Prove the general W4 shifted-inverse Schur-recovery inequality, or isolate its exact aggregate replacement, starting with a four-vertex path, a sign-frustrated cycle, and an unequal-weight degree-three star.
acceptance_checks: Reconstructs the audited matching, weighted-three-path, and equal-star slices before generalizing them.
Treats at least the four-path, a frustrated cycle, and an unequal-weight star analytically rather than by a parameter grid alone.
Retains the anisotropic child surplus and does not replace it by the known-false spectral-only bound.
Any positive result is transferred explicitly to K(A) and the strong expected-distance finite-time target.
